_about: Public-domain R. W. Dale (Robert William Dale, 1829-1895, Congregationalist, Carr's Lane, Birmingham) for the Word Hoard: The Atonement (1875 lecture, 22nd ed. 1902), Ephesians (6th ed. 1892), Christian Doctrine (1895), The Living Christ and the Four Gospels (catalogued 1890), Nine Lectures on Preaching (1877), Laws of Christ for Common Life (1884), Fellowship with Christ (catalogued 1892), Essays and Addresses (1899), Christ and the Future Life (1895) and A Manual of Congregational Principles (1884), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 17 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
